spec.interpretation: Own language-specific orthography/lexicon/prosody on an explicitly disclosed shared phoneme/formant engine is permitted in principle. Actual native phonetic fidelity, same-profile conversion, symbols and Windows/NVDA acceptance remain mandatory. A related-language voice alias cannot count as support.

pipeline: NFC native orthography validation and explicit language standard
Native lexical exceptions plus syllable/mora-aware G2P/prosody with structured unresolved cases
Own versioned phoneme map/voice configuration, using shared eSpeakNG acoustic primitives without foreign text/dictionary fallback
Actual generated calibration audio through the unchanged FP32 source encoder
Existing OpenVoice selected-profile conversion and normal cancellation/chunk queue
Prepared letter/command banks only from reviewed native names, with actual language/profile resource identity
reject: Unsupported characters, malformed diacritics, unknown orthographic systems
Unresolved lexical stress/hiatus/loanword cases advertised as certain
Foreign spellings sent through a neighboring-language spelling engine
Phonetic example words misrepresented as ordinary alphabet names
Missing phone inventory replaced by approximate neighboring phone
Random source vectors or reusing another carrier's source identity
implementation_boundary.lifecycle: Bind rule version, voice config, phoneme-table hash, calibration source, imported target profile and active package/resource epoch; fail closed on mutation. Shared formant data once, no per-profile model duplication.
acceptance: Verified native phoneme, stress, length and syllable golden cases plus explicit unsupported cases
Actual bundled Windows formant engine, calibration and selected-profile conversion; no loss of native contrasts
Literal native letter/digit/punctuation names, keyboard/navigation/cancel and package replacement regressions
Measured first/cold/warm PCM, RAM/disk and real NVDA output; numerical waveform generation alone is not pronunciation approval

existing_work.carrier: Explicit phonemes on Spanish acoustic table; not native Tongan-trained weights

concrete_defect.description: Current word() maps a macron vowel to two identical vowel segments, exactly as written double vowels. The mora/stress encoder then collapses long-vowel versus two-nucleus distinctions.
concrete_defect.counterexample_status: Source-dataflow deduction, not an executed new audio test.
concrete_defect.required_fix: Represent one long-vowel phone carrying two moras separately from two syllabic vowel nuclei; map stress to syllable head and preserve the contrast acoustically.

limits: Unwritten diphthong versus hiatus can need lexical/native evidence, even in 2024 official guidance.
Definitive/enclitic stress and compounds require explicit lexical/prosodic rules, not invented universal article heuristics.
No claim that standard orthography alone determines every intended pronunciation.

second_priority.assessment: Own standard Montenegrin phonology could use shared phonetic primitives, but ś/ź, native stress/pitch and standard selection must be real; Serbian renaming is not a solution. No new primary-source audit claimed here.
Requires primary native Itonama phonology and appropriate lexical/stress resources; not a defensible quick substitution. No new source acquisition claimed.

Southern Ndebele requires its own pronunciation/tone/orthography resources; Northern Ndebele alias remains invalid. No new source acquisition claimed.

conclusion: Pursue corrected Tongan own-phonemic route first, then licensed primary Hiri Motu resource acquisition. Keep Tetun/Afar as explicit native-rule candidates with identified data/prosody/rights gaps. This assessment adds no runtime language and closes no pronunciation/NVDA requirement.
